context: Adds error logging around the CSV export and switches CSV.open to a plain assignment 'so the rescue block can log the partial path'.
explanation: CSV.open(path, "wb") do |csv| ... end automatically flushes and closes the underlying file handle when the block exits, even on error. Replacing it with csv = CSV.open(path, "wb") followed by manual writes never closes the handle — not in the success path, and not in the new rescue branch either. Every export now leaks a file descriptor and risks buffered rows never being flushed to disk. Fix: keep the block form, or wrap the manual open in begin/ensure { csv.close }.
